gloss: cooking method; way of preparing food

definitions.gloss: cooking method; recipe; way of preparing food
definitions.explanation: A method or technique used to prepare food, such as grilling, steaming, frying, or boiling. Also used more broadly for recipes or preparation instructions.

examples.japanese: {調理法|ちょうりほう}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The flavor changes depending on the cooking method.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧{調理法|ちょうりほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}います→合う：10466_au⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What cooking methods suit this vegetable?

examples.japanese: ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{調理法|ちょうりほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えれば→変える：01089_kaeru⟧、まったく⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Even with the same ingredients, if you change the cooking method, it becomes a completely different dish.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{調理|ちょうり}→調理：07156_chouri⟧ (cooking, food preparation) and ⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧ (method, way). Refers to specific techniques like ⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧ (grilling), ⟦{蒸|む}す→蒸す：02307_musu⟧ (steaming), ⟦{煮|に}る→煮る：01971_niru⟧ (simmering), and ⟦{揚|あ}げる→揚げる：16879_ageru⟧ (deep-frying).

COMMON JAPANESE COOKING METHODS:
- ⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧ — to grill, roast, bake
- ⟦{煮|に}る→煮る：01971_niru⟧ — to simmer, stew
- ⟦{蒸|む}す→蒸す：02307_musu⟧ — to steam
- ⟦{揚|あ}げる→揚げる：16879_ageru⟧ — to deep-fry
- ⟦{炒|いた}める→炒める：01879_itameru⟧ — to stir-fry
- ⟦{茹|ゆ}でる→茹でる：02324_yuderu⟧ — to boil

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {調理法|ちょうりほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{工夫|くふう}する→工夫する：22180_kufuusuru⟧ — to be creative with cooking methods
- {調理法|ちょうりほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧ — to change the cooking method
- ⟦{基本的|きほんてき}→基本的：04787_kihonteki⟧な{調理法|ちょうりほう} — basic cooking methods

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦レシピ→レシピ：07157_reshipi⟧ — recipe (loanword, more common for specific instructions)
- ⟦{料理法|りょうりほう}→料理法：26096_ryourihou⟧ — cooking method (synonym, slightly less common)
- ⟦{調理|ちょうり}→調理：07156_chouri⟧ — cooking, food preparation (the process itself)
